The arithmetic behind it:

- Captures are counted **per mode**, not per objective. Clarity, conversion and trust are all Mode A-visit lenses, so they score **one** visit traversal three ways — adding the second and third costs no extra browsing.
- SEO is Mode C, a different mode, so it needs its own pass. A crawl is not a traversal and can't be approximated from the visit evidence.
- Mode C takes no persona, so your "one persona" multiplies only capture #1. One persona × 1 visit = 1; crawl = 1. **Total 2.**

Scoring after capture: 4 lenses (clarity, conversion, trust over capture #1; seo over capture #2), fanned out in parallel — plus an objectives scorer if you give the run objectives at interview.
